messages:
maria-sec: Auditor requested timeline + proof for an RBAC change that led to a service-account token rotation on 2025-11-05. They want CloudTrail entries, KMS key usage, and the Git PR that caused the change. Who can own exports?
jon-platform: I can pull CloudTrail + KMS audit. Question — do we send raw logs or a redacted subset? Auditor asked for requestIDs & principals, they said IPs can be redacted. Also need a mapping from events -> human-readable timeline.
auditor-rep: Minimal log fields are fine: timestamp, eventName, principalId, requestID, keyId. CSV or consolidated PDF is fine. We also want key version/rotation proof.
samir-devex: We have an evidence export script: `./scripts/export_evidence.sh --start 2025-11-05T00:00Z --end 2025-11-06T00:00Z --components cloudtrail,kms,git,secrets` — it zips and uploads to s3://redwood-evidence/. Need to know presigned TTL and whether to include raw requestPayloads (we usually redact user email). @jon-platform can you run and check for sensitive fields?
maria-sec: Two items to include: 1) the Git PR that introduced the RBAC change (PR 789) with merge commit and who approved; 2) KMS rotation event and a record showing the SA token was re-encrypted with the new key version. Can KMS audit show Encrypt/Decrypt with key version IDs?
jon-platform: Yes — CloudTrail records `Encrypt`/`Decrypt` with `requestParameters.keyId`. Example CloudWatch Logs Insights query I will run:```fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.principalId, requestParameters.keyId, eventID | filter @timestamp >= '2025-11-05T00:00:00Z' and @timestamp <= '2025-11-06T00:00:00Z' and (eventName like /CreatePolicy/ or eventName like /PutRolePolicy/ or eventName in ["Encrypt","Decrypt","GenerateDataKey"]) | sort @timestamp asc```I'll export CSV and upload. cc @samir-devex to kick off the script.
deploy-bot: export job started: export-job-9901 -> s3://redwood-evidence/exports/2791234000/export-job-9901.zip
samir-devex: Uploading export now. I'll generate presigned links with a 7-day TTL and add a README that lists what was redacted + a mapping file timestamps->evidence filenames.
auditor-rep: Also need evidence of incident response: the approval to rotate the token, decision notes, and the ticket that documents why we rotated. Slack thread or incident ticket export is fine provided role names and timestamps are preserved. If redacted, include role titles (e.g., "Security Lead") and timestamps.
maria-sec: We have the Jira ticket INF-4123 with comments and approvers. I'll export the ticket JSON (redact personal emails) and attach it to the bundle.
jon-platform: Quick status update: CloudTrail CSV upload complete: s3://redwood-evidence/exports/2791234000/cloudtrail.csv.gz (presigned link generated). KMS audit exported; shows KeyId arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-1234 and rotation event at 2025-11-05T03:12:24Z. Git PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/789 (merged by @opsbot, approvals by @alice and @devops).
auditor-rep: Received presigned links, thanks. One more: we need proof that old tokens were revoked — a secrets/secrets-manager rotation log or a listing showing revoked status. Please include the rotation step and the timestamp when the token became inactive.
samir-devex: Included Secrets Manager rotation log: rotation initiated and previous token state marked `Revoked`. Exported CSV contains `secretId,rotationTimestamp,previousVersionStatus`.
maria-sec: I'll put together the final evidence bundle and add a control mapping sheet: mapping artifacts to SOC 2 CC6.1 and ISO 27001 A.9.2 controls, plus a short narrative that ties the timeline to the control objective. ETA: EOD PT.
auditor-rep: That plan is fine. We'll review the bundle and follow up only if we need raw logs. Thanks :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: export job completed: export-job-9901 -> 3 files (cloudtrail.csv.gz, kms_audit.csv, secrets_rotation.csv)
maria-sec: Sent final bundle README + presigned links to auditor email. If they ask for raw payloads we will escalate through the standard evidence request process.
